description: This Java class 'SagePayPaymentServices' provides payment processing services for SagePay integration within the OFBiz framework, including authorization, capture, refund, void, and release operations, with detailed billing info construction and external service calls.

classes.name: SagePayPaymentServices
classes.description: A service class providing SagePay payment operations such as authorization, capture, refund, void, and release within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: buildCustomerBillingInfo
methods.description: Constructs billing information map from context, including card details and address, for payment processing.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Handles credit card authorization requests, invoking payment authentication service.

methods.name: processCardAuthorisationPayment
methods.description: Processes the actual card authorization by calling SagePayPaymentAuthentication service and handling response.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Handles capture of authorized payments, invoking payment authorization service for capture.

methods.name: processCardCapturePayment
methods.description: Processes capture payment by calling SagePayPaymentAuthorisation and handling response.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Handles refund requests, deciding between refund or void based on transaction age.

methods.name: processCardRefundPayment
methods.description: Processes refund by calling SagePayPaymentRefund and handling response.

methods.name: processCardVoidPayment
methods.description: Processes void payment by calling SagePayPaymentVoid and handling response.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Handles release of authorized funds, invoking payment release service.

methods.name: processCardReleasePayment
methods.description: Processes release by calling SagePayPaymentRelease and handling response.
